browser_acceptance.scope: 静态/HTTP测试不能证明浏览器布局。主线实跑结束由已有浏览器独立验收；任何需要补充Agent指令的版本判未通过。

extra_display_requirements: 预检结果中性说明，不残留启动前警告
窄屏阶段标签和数值不互相覆盖
test_scheduling: 公共冻结/canary及本地冻结检查严格串行。禁止扩大等待时间掩盖死worker或测试竞态。
additional_protocol_requirement: 九条主Prompt开头均限定项目内临时路径。默认本地测试使用公开acceptance.local_checks，在发现/导入前安装守卫，并把TMPDIR/TEMP/TMP及Python临时目录设为项目内；不能依赖tests/__init__副作用或裸discover命令。权限拒绝或无最终回复均未完成，不能追加恢复消息冒充通过。 路径约束：每步先从工具输出确认当前项目根目录。支持相对路径的命令和文件工具使用项目相对路径；要求绝对路径的写入工具，必须从刚确认的根目录原文生成，禁止重打、猜写目录名或日期。写入前确认父目录实际存在且属于本项目；无法确保时改用当前目录下的相对路径写入命令，不试探项目外写入。

累计半年词形、编号行名、附注与括号负数、表头索引及多组列
同一验收输出目录重复执行时旧任务与幂等键污染新一轮
additional_regressions.runner: Each CLI invocation creates a unique child output directory; root summary points to that invocation; within-case restart shares its persistent task root.

additional_regressions.problem: 无截止日或非六月末六个月、续页借用前页H1、同页无关表头误配
schema能力ID误作CLI命令，合成HTTP绕开真实argv分支
additional_regressions.boundary: Normal frozen worker and ReferenceClient, executable transport injection only; financials/income separate argv, complete envelope, no real call.

additional_regressions.problem: EPS排除句及缩放单位误证、公司表默认合并、六月中旬日期前缀误配、明确附注列裸括号编号误拒
positive_controls: full Jan1–Jun30 range
honest consolidated-only title without redundant scope row
unscaled EPS own-row unit
bare parenthesized note in explicit note column with negative financial cells preserved

additional_regressions.problem: 缩放或外币EPS单位包含元/股后缀而误放行；官方目标记录缺代码或null时跳过身份检查
positive_controls: unscaled yuan per share with and without explicit RMB
unscaled own EPS row inside a quote containing separate amount-scale context
normalized records with documented top-level code
negative_classes: each target CLI item missing/null/empty security code even with correct outer code

additional_regressions.problem: 有限EPS币种/倍率黑名单遗漏日元、欧元、未知前缀和新倍率，且拒绝合法专属人民币元说明
additional_regressions.mechanism: Bind and extract an entire EPS-own expression, then use a closed positive grammar shared by text and vision; no blacklist-plus-suffix acceptance.
positive_controls: bare basic-EPS label with own yuan/share caption
bare basic-EPS label with own RMB yuan/share caption
bare basic-EPS label with own RMB yuan caption
separate amount-scale context preserved
negative_classes: foreign and deterministically generated unknown currency prefixes
unallowed scale prefixes including RMB hundred/mega yuan per share

additional_regressions.problem: 完整EPS表达仅检查左前缀，右侧未知字符和无斜杠人民币元别名仍可部分匹配
additional_regressions.mechanism: Extract the entire EPS-own expression before positive full-match; all alias paths consume both boundaries.
positive_controls: all three declared unit aliases and separate amount-scale context
negative_classes: deterministic unknown left and right affixes applied to allowed aliases
own-row RMB-yuan suffix cannot use unanchored fallback

additional_regressions.problem: worker遗漏role参数使混合预设的视觉请求使用默认文字模型
additional_regressions.mechanism: One production stage-to-model boundary, asserted against actual retained requests through the normal frozen worker.
additional_regressions.scope: Offline qwen9 text9B/vision27B routing only; real financial validation remains separately scoped.

additional_regressions.problem: 同页完整表头被固定回看窗口排除，合法长表较后项目误拒
additional_regressions.mechanism: Same-page table intervals bind rows without a body-distance limit; every new table/header boundary ends the old interval, even when invalid.
positive_controls: different long body lengths and ordinary sections
later valid local table
local repeated header with different continuation order

additional_regressions.problem: 无新标题的局部列头借旧H1日期，忽略自身单季或冲突期间
additional_regressions.mechanism: Each header block owns and consistently resolves every local period declaration; rejected blocks remain barriers.
positive_controls: untitled repeated header with its own complete H1
negative_classes: H1 and Q2 in both orders

additional_regressions.problem: 正确毛利润与错误收入别名摘要同时存在；舍入展示和成本转换缺少语义约束
additional_regressions.mechanism: One source-derived Decimal review; durable exact expense normalization; actual production reviewCards selects by semantic ID with no duplicate summary/series.
positive_controls: fictional raw rounding trap through normal frozen worker
actual JS card selection and independent revenue/gross mutations
negative_classes: test-only card function unused by normal UI

additional_regressions.problem: 不完整的新项目列头因年份解析不足而被忽略，目标行沿用旧H1所有者
additional_regressions.mechanism: Recognize the explicit boundary before judging completeness; every rejected owner retains its interval and blocks fallback.
positive_controls: complete untitled H1 header
ordinary item/prose with project/note/year words
complete header after an incomplete empty block

additional_regressions.problem: 表题到列头仍受固定窗口限制，合法长表头丢失本块H1及合并口径
additional_regressions.mechanism: Consume the complete continuous metadata span in the existing same-page binder; structure determines ownership, never a distance constant.
positive_controls: 16/64 consistent unit-caption lines with three joint column orders
consolidated-only title plus two years without a scope row
one normal worker containing both long body and long header
negative_classes: long metadata followed by an incomplete owner
contradictory scope declarations in both orders
H1/Q2 declarations separated by long metadata in both orders

additional_regressions.problem: 存在一条H1且未发现Q2就通过，忽略同块其他明确非目标或不完整期间
additional_regressions.mechanism: Discover and normalize every whole explicit claim, retain other/unresolved, and require a nonempty set of all target-H1 claims in one shared binder.
positive_controls: repeated identical H1
equivalent Jan1–Jun30 H1 in both orders
existing ordinary-year body and year-only column components
additional_regressions.normal_worker: Same byte-exact two-page38/27 input; no additional worker.

additional_regressions.problem: 年份前缀让缺时长声明逃逸为裸日期target，column_path仍沿用独立any-H1判定
additional_regressions.mechanism: One closed PeriodCertificate consumed by local blocks and both column paths. Discover whole declarations before classification; retain unresolved and never rediscover a good substring from a bad declaration.
positive_controls: same explicit year on complete H1
equivalent H1 extra path component on current and prior
all existing ordinary-year and original H1 controls
additional_regressions.normal_worker: Same byte-exact38/27 two-page worker; new06 cases use pure compare, no new worker.

additional_regressions.problem: 同一fragment已有好H1时跳过后续缺损声明，去重fragment标记无法证明逐条完整认证
additional_regressions.mechanism: Enumerate and cover every declaration span before classification; retain each original span and reject uncovered or unresolved intent. Block/current/prior consume the same certificate.
positive_controls: two complete equivalent declarations in one fragment, both orders
all prior single and cross-fragment H1 controls
negative_classes: complete H1 plus missing-duration declaration in one fragment, both orders, block/current/prior
additional_regressions.normal_worker: Same byte-exact38/27 two-page worker; new06 cases are direct compare only.

additional_regressions.problem: 完整无年份起止日期未被发现，其他H1声明使原正控掩盖了已允许语法缺口
additional_regressions.mechanism: One optional-year grammar for discovery and whole-span classification of the three existing complete families; each family must suffice without another H1 form.
positive_controls: month_range, date_range, end_duration each with and without year as sole family in all owners
negative_classes: all existing216 calls retain missing-day/duration, other-window, composite-fragment and column-year controls
additional_regressions.normal_worker: Same byte-exact38/27 two-page worker; new06 cases are direct compare only.

additional_regressions.problem: 表题专属首期间前缀提前返回，漏掉同标题后续缺时长声明
additional_regressions.mechanism: Full raw title shares the existing fragment discovery and all-claims certificate; no first-prefix shortcut.
positive_controls: two existing complete H1 declarations in either title order
negative_classes: existing complete H1 plus missing-duration declaration in either title order
additional_regressions.normal_worker: Same byte-exact38/27 worker; only title and verbatim scope quote differ in four pure05/06 cases.

implementation_first_write_checkpoint: 第5步现在先执行首个生产检查点，不先阅读验收测试或fixture。确认根目录后，最多两次读取必要的现有生产接口或observation.schema片段，工具回传正文合计不超过6000字符；已在本对话中的约定不重复读取。随后立即把严格JSON回复解码与基本输入校验的最小可执行实现写入同一app/contracts.py、app/extract.py，并编译。这段必须真实识别合法对象、完整单围栏与非法传输，缺失的来源能力诚实失败，不能只写pass、TODO、未接入的helper或全为未实现的壳。首次业务写入前禁止读取acceptance测试体；首次写入和编译完成后立即运行through5公开检查。接着以首个真实失败为线索，每轮只读一个相关测试或fixture的局部定义，以80行和4000字符为参考目标；完整定义更长时只读当前失败所需的连续片段并记录实际范围；完成该段生产修正、编译和重测后再读下一段。先补输入/动作协议与完整数词，再补同一binder的表块、期间、列、单位绑定，最后接现有冻结TaskRunner来源循环。每段在当前消息内自动继续，不等新的指令。所有下文业务要求仍有效，最终完整through5全部11项及本地检查均须通过，不得改验收或以阶段性失败交付。
